actions.name: blood frenzy
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

actions.name: limited amphibiousness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

actions.name: shark telepathy
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

actions.name: aquatic charge
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} swims up to its Swim Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.
